notes: This contract records provider- and FOM-independent API checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 DataElement base surface in C++ and Java. The C++ check covers dynamic clone/type identity, encoded length and octet boundary, hash stability, complete append encoding, direct decode, and offset decode. The Java check covers ByteWrapper encoding and cursor position, byte-array conversion, encoded length and octet boundary, direct and current-position decode, and truncated-input failure. These are API contract checks only; they do not claim provider behavior or cross-RTI interoperability. No direct canonical requirement mapping is recorded without a pinned normative requirement for this base contract.

api_surfaces.signature: DataElement clone, type, encoding, boundary, hash, and decode operations
DataElement encode, byte-array conversion, encoded length/boundary, and decode operations
